steps.note: Relational geometry, unit-free (audit 6.5 example 4): every assertion names two painted things and asks how they relate, so it reads identically against TUI cells and GTK pixels.

Zone containment + anchored click (audit's worked-example vocabulary, quadraui#491): a project-tree row is inside the shell's registered sidebar-content zone, and clicking its right edge (not just its centre) still resolves to the row underneath.
